fields.Description: This FAQ page from the International Cheese Federation (ICF) provides detailed information regarding membership costs across various categories (Professional, Associate, Student, Emerging Professional, Retired, Corporate), eligibility criteria, mid-year prorated dues, refund policies, and procedures for rejoining or reviewing past denials. It outlines the benefits and management of corporate memberships and student verification requirements.

Membership & Dues 
 
Pricing, proration, eligibility, and how to join ICF 
 
 

 
 

← Back to FAQ 

 
 


How much does ICF membership cost? 

 
Annual membership dues vary by category: 
 

Professional Member: 
$295/year 


Associate Member: 
$195/year 


Student Member: 
$75/year 


Emerging Professional Member: 
$165/year 


Retired Member: 
$125/year 


Corporate Member: 
$1,295 (5 reps), $2,250 (10 reps), or $3,500 (20 reps) 
 
All memberships operate on a calendar-year basis (January 1 – December 31). 
 
 
 
 


What is the cost of an individual membership for a student? 

 
Student membership is 
$75/year 
. You must be enrolled full-time in a post-secondary degree or certificate program related to food science, dairy science, culinary arts, or hospitality management. 
 
Full-time means 12+ undergraduate credits or 6+ graduate credits per semester. You must submit proof of enrollment annually at 
members.intlcheese.org/student-verification 
. 
 
 
 
 


Is student membership available for culinary schools outside the U.S.? 

 
Yes. ICF student membership is open to full-time students in accredited programs worldwide. International students must provide documentation showing full-time enrollment status in their country’s educational system. 
 
Acceptable documentation includes official enrollment letters, transcripts, or student ID cards showing current semester dates. 
 
 
 
 


Do you offer group rates for a team of 5? 

 
Yes, through 
Corporate Membership 
. For 5 employees, the Basic tier costs 
$1,295/year 
($259 per person vs $295 individual rate). Each designated representative receives full individual member benefits including certification eligibility, member pricing, and online course access. 
 
Corporate administrators manage their roster through the member portal at 
members.intlcheese.org 
. 
 
 
 
 


If we join mid-year, do we still pay full dues? 

 
New members receive prorated dues based on join date: 
 

January – June: 
100% of annual dues 


July – September: 
50% of annual dues for remainder of current year 


October – December: 
Pay full following-year dues, receive remainder of current year free (15 months for 12 months’ price) 
 

Example: 
A Professional Member joining in November pays $295 and receives membership through December 31 of the following year. Proration only applies to new members. Renewals always pay full annual dues. 
 
 
 
 


What happens if we join and later decide ICF isn’t a fit? 

 
Membership dues are 
non-refundable 
once membership is activated. However, members experiencing extenuating circumstances may submit a written request for partial refund consideration to 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
. 
 
Requests must include supporting documentation and are reviewed case-by-case. Partial refunds, if approved, are calculated based on unused months of membership and processed within 30 days. 
 
 
 
 


I used to be a member five years ago. Do I have to pay an initiation fee to rejoin? 

 
ICF does not charge initiation fees. Former members rejoin by paying current-year dues at the standard rate for their membership category. Your previous membership history, including certification records and CEU transcripts, will be restored upon rejoining. 
 
Submit a new membership application at 
members.intlcheese.org/join 
or contact 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
for assistance. 
 
 
 
 


We were denied membership years ago. Has the criteria changed? 

 
Membership eligibility criteria are reviewed periodically by the Board of Directors. If you were previously denied, contact 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
with details about your situation. Staff can review current eligibility requirements for your membership category and advise whether circumstances have changed. 
 
Professional membership requires 50%+ time devoted to cheese-related work or an active ICF certification. Associate membership is available for those in cheese-related fields who don’t meet Professional criteria. 
 
 
 
 
 
Still have questions? 
 
Contact Member Services at 

memberservices@intlcheese.org 

or call 

+1 (555) 123-4567
